title: Occasions at Stone River

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Some occasions deserve more than a restaurant reservation or a crowded room at home. Occasions at Stone River offers a beautiful and versatile private event venue in Royse City, Texas, for celebrations, banquets, showers, organization events, family gatherings, and other special occasions. Whether you're celebrating a milestone, recognizing an accomplishment, or simply bringing a large group of people together, our venue gives you the space and flexibility to make the occasion feel special. With indoor and outdoor spaces, on-site catering, flexible event setup, and room for larger gatherings, we can help bring your event together without requiring you to coordinate every detail on your own.
